Routing · 2026-10-10T02:19Z — moving this card to `objectstack-ai/objectui`.

The producer named in the body is the Console's app index route (`@objectstack/console` is built from objectui's console / app-shell): when the current user's navigation resolves no landing page it renders the retired `StudioHomePage`. Issues live in the repo where the fix lands, and Console defects land in objectui. The maintainer's instruction for platform problems found in the objectstack-ai/hotclm#87 browser test, verbatim, 2026-10-10: 「你遇到的平台问题应该提交issue」.

The app-side half (the dev admin has no `clm_*` set, so HotCLM's navigation is empty for that account) stays with hotclm's decision cards objectstack-ai/hotclm#28 and objectstack-ai/hotclm#11 and is not part of this card.

Dedupe on `objectstack-ai/objectui` before moving: MCP `search_issues` `app index empty navigation falls back to Studio home page StudioHomePage` → 10 hits, none on this (nearest #11863, closed — the `/studio` landing header).

## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio` · `pm:queue`

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-10T03:55Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Re-read on objectui `main` `1b2d0160fe`:** `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx:1084` reads `landing ? <Navigate …/> : <StudioHomePage />`. Any app whose navigation is empty for the current user still lands on the retired Studio home.
- **Why p2:** a signed-in user lands on a page that is not about their app and has no next step. Any app with capability-gated navigation reaches it for a user without grants.
- **Direction:**
  - The empty-navigation fallback is an app-level empty state that says the caller has no access in this app yet.
  - For a caller who can grant access, it links to Setup.
  - ⛔ Never the Studio home. `/studio` itself is untouched.
- **Out of scope:** whether HotCLM's dev admin should hold `clm_*` sets is hotclm's decision (objectstack-ai/hotclm#28, #11).
- **Pins:** an app with empty navigation renders the empty state, not `StudioHomePage`. Control: an app with a landing page still navigates to it.

Container & model: `M` (small, but the empty state is a design judgment, not a mechanical edit), `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier — dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui: "no path-derived mandate"`
Clause-②: yes
Responsibility: `objectui's app-shell console AppContent.tsx app index route, which renders the retired StudioHomePage when the navigation resolves no landing page | none: no platform empty state exists for an app the caller has no access in | any signed-in user whose app navigation resolves empty, measured on objectstack-ai/hotclm#87 (17.7.0) for the dev admin; used today by every capability-gated app`
Thread-read: 6093511804
Serial constraints cleared: none. No in-flight card touches `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`. (Corrected: an earlier version of this line named objectui#7611 as dispatched in this round. That card is reserved for the epic lane of objectstack-ai/objectstack#15194, `6095619495`, and this seat yielded it in `6095645635`. Its surface is `apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx`, a different file.)

Clause-② is declared `yes` because the empty state's copy will add published locale keys. The in-seat review needs that reason.

## ACCEPT — PR objectui#12091 (head `02569f377f`) · `domain:ui` seat 3, `session_01B1gHb9baeX7oioD5sHVm7z`, 2026-10-10T12:47Z

Reviewed against GitHub and the diff, not the report (`6096347163`).

- **Shape:**
  - The PR is a draft on `main`.
  - Its first line is `Fixes #12079`, and `Clause-②: yes` sits at the start of a line.
  - No other card number sits near a closing keyword.
  - The assignee is `marchtian`.
- **Scope:** 15 files, +473/−6: `AppContent.tsx`, two new app-shell modules, one new test file, four keys in each of the ten locale packs, and one changeset. Nothing touches `content/docs/releases/` and no file is unrelated. NOT GOVERNED.
- **The diff against triage (`6093511804`):**
  - An app that serves the caller no navigation now opens on `AppNoAccessEmptyState`, which names the app. Setup is linked only for the console's existing workspace-administrator verdict, at the `/setup` deep-link URL.
  - A landing still navigates.
  - The Studio app, whose navigation is all `component` items, keeps its home. `/studio` is untouched.
- **Contract review:** `6097645373`, `Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, **PASS** on this head. The `yes` is carried by four additive i18n keys. No export is added.
- **CI on `02569f377f`:** 43 runs, 40 success, 3 skipped by design, 0 failed.
- **Eager closure, measured by the dev:** +311 B gzipped. Headroom went from 35.9 KB to 35.6 KB.
- **Changeset prose, checked sentence by sentence against the diff:**
  - "now opens on an app-level empty state, not on the Studio home";
  - "the app's own label";
  - "A user the console treats as a workspace administrator (`useWorkspaceAdminStatus` …) gets an 'Open Setup' link, at the URL the `/setup` deep link resolves";
  - "The Studio app still opens on its own home";
  - "New `@object-ui/i18n` keys, in all ten language packs".

  All match. It is `@object-ui/app-shell: patch` with `@object-ui/i18n: patch`.
- **Out of scope:**
  - A non-Studio app with non-empty navigation but no walkable landing (`doc`-only, or items only under `areas`) still lands on `StudioHomePage`. It predates this PR. objectstack `origin/main` has no app or example declaring `areas` (zero hits; control: `navigation: [` hits three apps). It goes to Acceptance notes and is not filed.
  - Whether the Studio app's own root should keep `StudioHomePage` (the card body calls it retired) goes to the maintainer in the round report. It is not a condition of this card.

**Landing:** ready + auto-merge through the queue, now.
